verdicts.originalText: The Pyro DMG Bonus scales at +5% per Scarlet Seal consumed: max +15% at C0 (3 seals) or +20% at C6 (4 seals). Seals are now tracked automatically (N hits +1, E/Q to max, CA consumes all); `{seal:N}` assertions remain available as a manual override.

The word 'now' marks this as a stale transitional note from when auto-tracking landed. Fails the purpose test, so delete (mirrors the Kazuha worked example).
